The thresholds the bands were computed with, so a screen explains them
without restating them.
BandRules.title: BandRules

CostLine.description: What Getronics staff see: the provider's charge to Getronics.
CostLine.title: CostLine

CustomerPrice.description:
What a customer sees instead of cost (ADR 0021): its consumption at the
price Getronics charges, for one closed calendar month and nothing finer, so
no single line's price can be isolated (decision 8). ``price`` is None, and
``not_captured`` says why, when any line in the month has no uplift in force:
never the cost, never a zero.
CustomerPrice.title: CustomerPrice

FigureSnapshot.description:
A figure as generated: the value is unrounded text (an int, or a Decimal
in ``unit`` for money); presentation rounds it once.
FigureSnapshot.title: FigureSnapshot

Reported.description: The contract-currency margin converted for the viewer, FX impact apart.

ResourceStaffView.description: What Getronics staff see: provider identifiers and tags as well.
ResourceStaffView.title: ResourceStaffView

ResourceView.description: What a customer sees of a resource.

ScreenContext.description: Where the panel was opened. A hint, re-checked under the resolved scope.
ScreenContext.title: ScreenContext

TriageOverrides.description:
What a reviewer may change: the classification's fields, each to a value its
schema allows. Typed here so the console's choices come from the contract.
TriageOverrides.title: TriageOverrides

get.description: Every scheduled connector, worst first, with its band and why.

Cloud consumption by provider and transaction currency. Staff see the
provider's charge to Getronics over the last ``days``. A customer sees the
price Getronics charges it (ADR 0021) for each of the last ``months``
closed calendar months, and nothing finer. Given ``currency``, each figure
is also converted at the rate in force on each usage date; a figure with any
day unconverted has none.

schema.title: Response List Fx Corrections V1 Finops Fx Corrections Get

post.description:
Finance corrects a rate. Its inverse and every pair with the moving
currency are re-derived from the EUR rates on the same day, each with its own
entry; the returned entry is the first that moved. The closed months it
touches are restated by the next month-end reprocessing, as new versions;
nothing closed is overwritten.

get.description:
Every customer in scope for one invoice period: cost by charge class, the
reconciliation verdict, unallocated spend and recent anomalies. Staff work:
a customer reads its own cost through the portal (step 18).
